title: Longest Balanced Multi-Bracket Substring
description: Given a string `s` consisting of the six bracket types `'('`, `')'`, `'['`, `']'`, `'{'`, and `'}'`, return the length of the longest contiguous substring of `s` that is validly balanced across all three bracket types.
hints: Push (bracketChar, index) pairs onto a stack initialized with a sentinel ('#', -1).
When a closing bracket matches the top opening bracket, pop it and update the answer with i - stack.top.index; if it does not match, push the closing bracket itself as a new boundary barrier.

examples.explanation: The substring "[()]" has length 4, while the mismatched ']' at index 5 breaks any longer valid span.
The substring "{[()]}[]" from index 1 to 8 has length 8.
No pair of matching brackets is validly nested in "([)]", so the answer is 0.
